    Privacy Policy (Version 1.0)

    Last updated: 13/02/2026]

    1. Who We Are

    The &Improve product family—includes Write & Improve, Speak & Improve, Read & Improve. This Privacy Policy explains how they use, store, and protect your personal data.

    These services are provided by:

    [Insert Cambridge Legal Entity Name]
    Registered address:
    Contact:
    Data Protection Officer: [email / link]

    We are committed to protecting your privacy and handling your data in a transparent, fair, and lawful way.

    2. Scope of This Privacy Policy

    This policy applies to all &Improve learning services and features, including:

    • Writing feedback
    • Speaking and audio-based activities
    • Reading comprehension experiences
    • Personalised learning features
    • User accounts and profiles
    • The shared identity system that powers the &Improve family

    This policy does not cover other Cambridge digital products unless specifically referenced.

    For how we use learner‑generated content in research, benchmarking, and model training, please see the separate:

    👉 Research & Corpus Data Use Statement

    3. The Personal Data We Collect

    We collect only the information necessary to provide the service, improve the learning experience, ensure safety, meet legal obligations, and—where you choose to permit it—support research and development.

    3.1 Account & Identity Data

    • Name
    • Email address
    • Password or authentication credentials
    • Parent or guardian contact details (for under‑13s or as required by regional law)

    3.2 Learning & Activity Data

    • User’s role: teacher or learner
    • Learner’s first language
    • Learner’s learning goals
    • Learner’s target exams
    • Teachers’ target exams
    • Writing submissions
    • Audio recordings used for speaking assessments or feedback
    • Reading comprehension responses
    • System-provided scores, progress data, and CEFR-related metrics

    3.3 Device & Technical Data

    • Device identifiers
    • Browser or app type
    • IP address
    • Cookies and similar technologies (see Cookie Policy)
    • General usage analytics

    3.4 Research & Corpus Data

    Some learner output may be processed for research and development purposes, including improving automated feedback systems and benchmarking language performance. This is explained separately in the:

    👉 Research & Corpus Data Use Statement

    3.5 Children’s Data

    If you are a child user or a parent/guardian supporting a child’s use:

    • Age or date of birth
    • Parental consent or verification data
    • Restrictions applied based on age

    4. How We Use Personal Data

    We use your personal data in the following ways:

    4.1 To Provide the Core Learning Service

    • Deliver writing, speaking, and reading feedback
    • Show progress, scores, and personalized study recommendations
    • Maintain your account and profile
    • Support the unified learning experience across &Improve products

    4.2 To Improve and Maintain the Services

    • Ensuring system functionality and performance
    • Improving accuracy of automated scoring and feedback
    • Analysing aggregated usage trends to enhance the learning experience

    4.3 For Research and Development

    Where permitted:

    • Benchmarking model performance
    • Supporting the development of educational technology
    • Improving language assessment models
      (See Research & Corpus Data Use Statement)

    4.4 To Ensure Platform Safety

    • Detecting misuse, fraud, or harmful behaviour
    • Maintaining secure and stable systems
